title: Digital Cheesecake: Marketing and Growth Podcast
author: Jack Johnson | Blu Digital & Ellie Farrugia | Kinsman and Co
description: Most marketing podcasts tell you what sounds good. We tell you what's ACTUALLY working Hosted by Jack & Sarah Johnson (UK leading recruitment experts placing top talent) and Ellie Farrugia (Award Winning Marketing Agency Founder). Digital Cheesecake is unfiltered conversations served straight to the people driving the industry forward. From hiring decisions and career growth to strategy, performance, and industry shifts, nothing’s watered down. Expect: Honest conversations with CMOs & Founders What’s really happening in marketing Challenges No One Talks About Follow on Apple & YouTube!
